datasets.dataset_name: CEREC: Corpus for Entity Resolution in Email Conversations
datasets.version: COLING 2020 author release; paper has updated author version
datasets.license: Author repo identifies Apache-2.0; paper states CC BY 4.0. Scope for the Enron-derived message text embedded in corpus files is not explicit; treat message-bearing corpus redistribution rights as unresolved.
intended_component: email entity mention and coreference auxiliary supervision
datasets.mapping_policy: Preserve source entity and chain annotations. Do not convert them into FYP labels. Enron overlap controls apply across MailEx, Parakweet, CEREC, and all FYP splits.

counts.observed_note: No local archive parse. Chain count differs between the original paper/repo and updated author paper.
